messages:
Maya (partnerships): kicking off publisher onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure. objective: get trial listing live with entitlement token + partner-facing runbook.
Connor (product): baseline: 14-day trial, 5 seats, metered vCPU. need a short blurb and a badge for the listing.
Aisha (legal): i need the exact blurb + where trial telemetry is stored. add opt-in for retention beyond trial.
Ravi (eng): artifacts required: signed AMI (aws), GCP image or import tar, Azure VHD or container image. SBOM + scan report mandatory.
Sofia (cloud-ops): publish prerequisites: aws publisher account id + role arn; gcp project + service account with compute.imageUser; azure publisher id + SAS/ACR push access.
Hiro (partner-success): partner wants a one-click trial activation. can we pre-provision entitlements?
Sofia (cloud-ops): yes. we can mint ephemeral entitlement tokens tied to a staging tenant (TTL 30d).
Diego (security): gating: no critical vulns, high vuln review required. require SBOM, image signing, and minimal runtime user.
Ravi (eng): example assume-role policy we accept (AWS):
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::PUBLISHER_ACCOUNT:role/MarketplacePublishRole"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]}
```
Ravi (eng): example manifest fields: name, version, sku_id, trial_days, checksum, sbom_url. please use sha256 for checksums.
Hiro (partner-success): i'll request partner uploads to staging bucket, gzipped tar, include manifest.json. will share link + checksum.
Staging-Bot: staging-creds created -> https://ci.internal/creds/pub-temp-321 (expires 2026-04-20)
Maya (partnerships): action items: 1) Ravi + Sofia - publish checklist + exact IAM names (EOD). 2) Aisha + Connor - trial T&Cs + listing blurb (48h). 3) Hiro - artifact link + manifest (EOD). 4) Diego - security gate template + SBOM headers (EOD).
Connor (product): i'll add a tiny QA harness for entitlement redemption + billing ping (curl examples).
Ravi (eng): i'll add perf notes (recommended instance families) and a smoke-test script.
Diego (security): will draft attestation for data residency + logging; trial telemetry retention default 30d unless opted in.
Aisha (legal): i'll include early-conversion billing policy and opt-out wording.
Hiro (partner-success): partner confirms upload tonight and will provide keys for uploader access.
Maya (partnerships): great. i'll assemble a one-pager runbook linking checklists and open publish ticket. ping here with blockers. :white_check_mark:
